SJ Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

EASTINDIA.BO.longBusinessSummary: East India Drums and Barrels Manufacturing Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of drums and barrels, and allied products in India. The company also lends the money for other business purposes. The company was formerly known as Tatia Finnancial Services Limited and changed its name to Kreon Finnancial Services Limited in 2008. Kreon Finnancial Services Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

DHRUVCA.BO.longBusinessSummary: Dhruva Capital Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the business of investment and financing in India. It also provides EV/CV, gold, personal, and home loans, as well as loans against properties for individuals. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kolkata, India.

MAHACOAL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited produces and sells non-coking coal. It provides various grades of non-coking coal, including washed/beneficiated coal to the power utilities sector, including state power utilities, private power utilities, captive power plants, and independent power producers, as well as non-power industries comprising the cement sector and sponge iron sector. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Sambalpur, India. Mahanadi Coalfields Limited is a subsidiary of Coal India Limited.

VGL.BO.longBusinessSummary: Varvee Global Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers poplin, oxford, twill, dobby, chambray, and satin weaves, as well as other denims. The company was formerly known as Aarvee Denims and Exports Ltd. and changed its name to Varvee Global Limited in August 2025. Varvee Global Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
